$comment: Scoop fallback for the WinGet Configuration in dev/windows.dsc.yaml —
for contributors who already run Scoop, or whose winget source index is
broken. Apply with:  scoop import dev/scoop.json
NOT covered here: the Visual Studio Build Tools. Scoop has no installer
for VS workloads, and the MSVC C toolchain is required (bundled sqlite,
libgit2, LMDB, zlib, tree-sitter, ring all compile C). Install it once
or the GUI installer, selecting 'Desktop development with C++'.
As with the DSC manifest, nothing here touches the machine PATH; run

apps.Name: git
apps.$comment: Required at runtime AND supplies the POSIX userland the tests spawn.

apps.Name: rustup
apps.$comment: Channel + components come from rust-toolchain.toml, not from here.

apps.Name: windows-terminal
apps.$comment: thegn refuses to start under legacy conhost.exe.
